note: Applicability guards applied BEFORE a fired rule reaches the synthesis layer. The rule packs themselves are not edited (that would change /api/reasoning); each entry records why the fired rule cannot be used as-is and what the synthesis layer does instead. Produced from tools/semantic_audit.py and manual reading of the rule text. Actions: recheck_scope (the book names a narrower geometry than the pack condition: re-verify the named star in that scope), use_description (the shared claim label carries a condition this rule does not check: narrate from the rule's own paraphrase), exclude (cannot be used in synthesis).

auto.note: Generic guards applied to every rule. limit_label: a rule whose effect is 'limit' but whose shared label reads as a positive outcome (e.g. Hóa Lộc ở Tứ Mộ dùng nhãn 'tài lộc thuận lợi') is narrated from its own paraphrase and treated as LIMITING the concept, never as supporting it. structural_duplicate: a chart-level structure finding asserted once per palace of a triad (e.g. TV_STRUCT_SAT_PHA_THAM_001) counts once.
